# Parse the note content to extract the TODO songs
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- "
        line_clean = line[2:] if line.startswith('- ') else line
        # Split on " BY " to get title and the rest
        if ' BY ' in line_clean:
            title_part, rest = line_clean.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains "Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
            # Split on " RELEASED_AT " to get artists
            artists_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ')[0]
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            todo_songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            print("Could not parse line:", line)
print("Number of TODO songs:", len(todo_songs))
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s['title'], '|', s['artists'])
